protocol: 22 fresh context-free player readers; eight gated stages, immutable all-guest suspicion scores, locked accusations before finale. Actual printed artifacts and rendered images, selected spoken branches only. No prior results, murderer assignment or desired score distributions exposed. No rerolls. AI reading checks, not a human party simulation. No game edits during testing. Single guest-chain order is represented by one legal grouped ordering. Single-reader top3 is a proxy for group votes; named innocents read first in a legal alphabetical order, murderer last.
